name: Modern Cylinder Pedestal with Turntable
description: Our Museum Quality Cylinder Pedestal - Turntable - Brushed Aluminum Laminate Surface - 20.5" x 3"6" (Diameter x Height) is a column display with class. The turn table on top adds the ability to rotate whatever is being displayed on top giving you the ability to show off every angle of your valuable. The laminate finish is countertop grade and so easy to keep clean that your pedestal will shine for years to come. There will be no unsightly seams on the top edge where the core color of the laminate shows. We color match the edge for a very clean look and we have listed a number of standard sizes that will accommodate many different displays from sculptures, pottery, models, vases, artifacts to trade show samples and new items. The prices are below market and affordable, so it's easy to set up multiple size pedestals to create an eye-catching display for your gallery, office, home, foyer or trade show.
